recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Handle any remaining cleanup around retired DocumentManifest references, List XDS mappings, or the external list-category extension under their own Jira keys rather than under FHIR-17297.
issue_request: FHIR-17297 was a Published/Persuasive SD issue for STU3 DocumentManifest. It requested that DocumentManifest.type describe the clinical activity that resulted in placing associated content into the DocumentManifest, remove the Document Type Value Set binding, and use an example ActCode binding because XDS SubmissionSet.contentTypeCode is not a document-type value.
initial_application: Historical commit 6fbb7de857bcd3b0a9de6efb2f384ccb08b05b92, titled 'DocumentManifest GF#17297', matches the Jira comment revision and changed DocumentManifest.type from the DocumentC80Type binding to v3Act while replacing the old definition with the requested clinical-activity wording.
additional_context: FHIR-13969 was the same request submitted against the wrong ballot and then cloned into FHIR-17297. The current core source comments DocumentManifest as dropped in source/fhir.ini, maps DocumentManifest to List, and keeps List as the active resource. DocumentManifest was removed by ea941737076615e7e2772299c80c63e1490f2e93, and FHIR-39006 later moved XDS mappings and an XDS example to List. The related List category extension from FHIR-19822 is now in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than this core checkout.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The original DocumentManifest.type request was already applied before DocumentManifest was retired, and applying its old wording or binding to the broad current List.code element would over-apply a DocumentManifest-specific decision to a different resource.
